title: Extending Evaluation Awareness Probes to Detect Reward Hacking Activation Signatures

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If evaluation-awareness probes generalize to reward hacking, this reveals a unified internal representation for strategic behavior -- a significant interpretability insight with broad monitoring implications.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires activation extraction from Llama-3-8B on MALT runs and training linear probes. Methodology is documented in the reference paper. Single GPU feasible but activation extraction from agentic transcripts adds engineering complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single model, single dataset, one probe comparison. However, MALT transcripts are multi-step agent runs requiring careful activation extraction point selection. Scope is clean but execution may push 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
